episodes.title: Cutline
episodes.summary: Kirby Mazrachi suspects her attacker from years earlier may be responsible for a recent murder, but she's challenged by her shifting reality.

episodes.title: Evergreen
episodes.summary: After new evidence supports Kirby's theory, reporter Dan Velazquez weighs using her as a source. Kirby takes a closer look at the victim.

episodes.title: Overnight
episodes.summary: Kirby and Dan look to the past, uncovering multiple cold cases with puzzling similarities. Harper takes a dangerous new interest in Dan.

episodes.title: Attribution
episodes.summary: As pressure mounts to go to print, Dan explores possible connections between the murder victims. Kirby tries to make sense of a piece of evidence.

episodes.title: Screamer
episodes.summary: Dan's article gains traction across the city. After a harrowing encounter, Kirby's grasp of reality comes into question.

episodes.title: Bright
episodes.summary: When Harper returns home from war, he finds a new beginning.

episodes.title: Offset
episodes.summary: A fresh lead sparks a breakthrough in the story. After Kirby drops a bombshell on Marcus, she goes to help a new friend.
Season finale. As Kirby's reality spirals, she sets her sights on finally tracking down Harper.
